headline: 🔴 Unpatched Microsoft UFO MCP flaw (CVSS 9.4), 🛒 Superior campaign hits 80k browser extension users, 🔓 Composer path traversal CVE-2026-59944, 🤖 Gryxa AI-built persistence toolkit, 🎯 Blind Eagle AsyncRAT via GitHub, 📶 D-Link unauthenticated admin reset, 🍪 Infostealer malware hijacks Claude sessions, 💰 Berlin refuses to pay extortionists, 🖨️ PaperCut emergency zero-day patches
summary: A critical unpatched CVSS 9.4 flaw in Microsoft's UFO Desktop AgentOS framework enables unauthenticated Android device takeover via the Mobile Model Context Protocol. The browser extension supply chain takes another hit as the Superior campaign compromised 18 extensions affecting 80k users. PaperCut emergency patches for actively exploited zero-days were bypassed within a day, forcing a second release.
